evidence_class: development: engineered runtime plus trained small neural network; not an LLM or human experiment
rules: No claim of SAN-specific advantage from a programmed guard or synthetic generator.
No test-dependent tuning within this protocol.
Worlds, not intervention rows, are the primary within-model sampling units.
Three training seeds are descriptive replications, not external validation.
All surrogate outcomes, including adverse outcomes, are retained.
Live feedback, open-weight LLMs, endogenous access, human oversight, biological transfer and independent review remain separate unexecuted stages.
